Based on the retrieved excerpts, **clause 8.1.4** directly addresses your situation.

This clause requires that "outsourced functions and processes must be controlled to a degree consistent with the risk, defined within the OH&S system" [Doc 1 — clause 8.1.4]. Since you're outsourcing your entire janitorial and facilities-upkeep function, this sub-clause explicitly applies to ensure those outsourced activities remain controlled within your OH&S management system.

Additionally, **clause 8.1.1** is relevant as it requires controlling and maintaining processes needed to meet OH&S system requirements, including "in multi-employer workplaces — coordinating the relevant parts of the system with other organizations" [Doc 2 — clause 8.1.1].
